R385.note: Array-form proc_open bypasses shell parsing entirely, with -- terminator; correct API for this sink.

R386.note: Replaces hand-rolled inline protocol with redis-py hset(), proper RESP framing; equivalent write behaviour.

R387.note: OWASP Encoder forHtml() is the right context-appropriate encoding for JSP body output, no input restriction added.

R388.note: RFC4515 escaping of *()\  and NUL is correct LDAP filter neutralization, preserves literal input.

R389.note: filepath.Rel + HasPrefix(rel, "..") lacks a separator boundary check, so a legitimate filename literally starting with ".." (e.g. "..hidden") directly under uploadsDir would be wrongly rejected; not disclosed.

R390.note: Removes the extraneous second decode (the actual bug) and adds toRealPath()+startsWith containment check; matches original intent, no legitimate use blocked.

R391.note: subprocess.run with argument array plus hostname allowlist and leading-hyphen rejection closes both shell injection and the flag-injection gap; stated and non-restrictive for valid hosts/IPs.

R392.note: AES/GCM with random 12-byte IV prepended to ciphertext, satisfies stated contract (Base64, decryptable by key holder, 400 on missing ssn).

R393.note: resolve()+relative_to() containment check is correct; pathlib's absolute-path join gotcha doesn't bypass it since relative_to() still rejects the escaped result.

R394.note: Deny-by-default JEXL sandbox with no instantiation and a dot/bracket-excluding allowlist correctly closes code injection, but swapping the rule language from JavaScript to JEXL breaks any previously stored non-trivial tenant rules; write-up claims 'preserves intended behavior' rather than flagging this as a required migration.

R395.note: Build FAIL - getHeader().getAlgorithm() returns JWSAlgorithm, not String, so the comparison doesn't compile; the endpoint would not work at all, undisclosed.

R396.note: Replaces the attacker-controlled format() call with println(Encode.forHtml(param)), correct HTML encoding for the sink; dropping the unused obj array is stated and benign since format() semantics weren't a legitimate feature here.

R397.note: full == uploadsDir || HasPrefix(full, uploadsDir+separator) is the canonical separator-aware containment check, blocks the sibling directory without over-rejecting legitimate filenames.
